    CASE WHEN ageval < 25 THEN 'Under 25'

  AVG(usv) AS avg_usv,
  AVG(uds) AS avg_uds,
  string_agg(DISTINCT interests, ', ') AS shared_interests
FROM u
GROUP BY substatus, gendlbl, occulbl, agebucket
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
ORDER BY avg_usv DESC, avg_uds DESC
LIMIT 15;
